title: Independent Police Complaints and Misconduct Authority Bill
source_or_instruction: Public interest reform proposal establishing independent District and State Police Complaints Authorities headed by retired judges, direct investigative powers to register FIRs, and mandatory inquiries into police brutality.
notes: Matter 019: Independent Police Complaints and Misconduct Authority Bill, 2026.
